questions.q: After a 15% increase, a price is $69. Find the original price.
questions.why: Reverse percentage: divide by the multiplier, 69 ÷ 1.15 = 60.

questions.q: $72 is shared in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. Find the largest share.
questions.why: There are 9 parts, so 1 part = $8 and the largest share is 4 × 8 = $32.

questions.q: A price falls from $80 to $68. Find the percentage decrease.
questions.why: Decrease ÷ original = 12 ÷ 80 = 0.15 = 15%; never divide by the new value.

questions.q: Without a calculator, work out 1¾ ÷ 2⅓. Give your answer in its simplest form.
